question: Should affected shared databases automatically canonicalize `task_runs.delivery_status = 'not-requested'` during database open, in addition to normalizing future sidecar imports?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and well-proven, but automatic mutation of persisted user state is an upgrade-boundary decision protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept automatic repair
options.body: Use the proposed idempotent one-literal transaction so already-archived upgrades self-heal without manual SQL or an archived sidecar.

options.title: Require explicit doctor repair
options.body: Move the existing-database repair behind a doctor migration, accepting that affected runtime opens remain broken until the operator runs it.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic repair
recommendation.body: Use the proposed idempotent one-literal transaction so already-archived upgrades self-heal without manual SQL or an archived sidecar.

likelyOwner.reason: Their shared task-state refactor established the migration and restoration boundary being changed.
